nodes.name: Lead webhook
nodes.notes: POST JSON from the Next.js API route. Select a Header Auth credential here (the secret stays server-side in the app).

nodes.name: Validate and normalize
nodes.notes: Why Code: IF/Set considered. Per-field error messages for the caller plus name/text normalisation need a loop over the schema. Config (team email, sheet id, website, WhatsApp) lives in CONFIG at the top.

nodes.name: Save lead to sheet
nodes.notes: One node for all four tabs: the tab is chosen by gid from the enquiry type.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, data: { reference: $('Prepare lead').first().json.lead.reference, trackToken: $('Prepare lead').first().json.lead.trackToken, message: 'Thank you. nodes.name: Build emails
nodes.notes: Why Code: Set/expression considered. Two HTML email templates with escaping and conditional rows replace 8 duplicated 5 KB expressions. Runs after the webhook response is sent.

parameters.subject: Your Oluwaseyi Homes & Properties verification code
parameters.message:
={{ "

OLUWASEYI HOMES & PROPERTIES

Your verification code

Enter this code on the website to finish sending your enquiry.

" + $json.code + "

The code works for " + $json.minutes + " minutes. If you did not ask for it, you can ignore this email.

" }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, data: { step: 'code', message: 'We sent a 6-digit code to your email. Enter it below to finish. The code works for 10 minutes.' }, error: null } }}

={{ { success: false, data: null, error: 'We could not process your enquiry just now. Please try again shortly.' } }}
={{ { success: false, data: null, error: 'We could not save your property just now. Your payment is recorded. Please try again shortly.' } }}
={{ { success: true, data: { reference: $json.code, message: 'Thank you. We have received your property and your listing fee. We will review it and contact you.' }, error: null } }}

nodes.name: Save listing to sheet
nodes.notes: Adds one row to the List Property tab for every paid owner submission (rent or sale). Runs next to the team email, after the owner has been answered, so a sheet problem never delays anything. Written as plain text (RAW) so phone numbers keep their leading zero and nothing can become a formula.

value.Category: ={{ $('Check submission').first().json.p.purpose === 'Rent' ? 'List property to rent' : 'List property to sell' }}
value.Name: ={{ $('Check submission').first().json.p.fullName }}
